rails.notes: Commercial receiving rail. Verify payer-supported currency/region/terms per opportunity; no payment is PAID without transaction evidence.

inventory_rule: This file records recovered rails; absence from this file is NOT proof that AMX lacks another receiving rail. Recover authoritative wallet/payment evidence before rejecting an opportunity for incompatibility.

known_unmaterialized_payment_evidence.safe_fact: An existing OKX.AI / Agentic Wallet identity is documented; do not create a duplicate.

program_provided_wallet_rule: A program-provided/bound wallet/account is a separate onboarding case; do not require it to match Matrix-held wallet inventory.
secret_control: Never store private keys, seed phrases, recovery material, passwords or equivalent custody secrets here.
